guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Connect your wallet to Entropy
guide.description: Go to the Entropy trading app and connect Rabby, MetaMask, or another supported wallet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Set your username
guide.description: Finish account setup and pick a username.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit USDC to your Hyperliquid account
guide.description: Entropy markets settle in USDC held in your Hyperliquid perps balance, funded via Arbitrum. Buy USDC on Bybit and withdraw straight to Arbitrum, or shift existing funds across chains using the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade the live Entropy markets
guide.description: Open positions on io:ANTH, io:SNDK, io:NBIS, or io:GPRO. Leverage caps run from 5x to 10x by market, and isolated margin keeps any liquidation contained to that position.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Create or apply a referral code
guide.description: Generate a code on the referrals page to earn a share of fees from signups. Applying someone else’s code gives you a fee benefit matching their tier.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Build volume on Entropy markets
guide.description: Rebate tiers track rolling 30-day volume on Entropy markets. Volume on native Hyperliquid perps like BTC or ETH counts for Hyperliquid but not toward Entropy tiers.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
